【原视频简介】
this was genuinely way more difficult than i expected, especially the last one...

There are 126 advancements in modern Minecraft java edition, but this doesn't even come close to every vanilla Minecraft achievement. If you include removed, hidden and version exclusive achievements, that number jumps to 305. If you include recipe unlocks, which the game technically counts as advancements, the number shoots up even higher to 1,867 total achievements in vanilla Minecraft. So, in order to truly 100% Minecraft by actually getting every achievement, I'm embarking on a journey to get all of these advancements, starting with all 126 in modern Minecraft java edition.

subscribe for more videos :)
